name: cell
description: Burdens fitting a wartime resistance cell. Includes the special INFORMANT burden — at most one cell member carries it per rotation.

burdens.text: I am an informant. The authorities have a member of my family. I report to them weekly via dead-drop. I have not yet given them anything that got someone killed, but the time is coming when I will have to choose. They know my real name. The cell does not.
I gave up a name under interrogation six months ago. I was let go. The cell believes I held. I have been waiting for the consequences ever since.
I keep a journal in my flat. Names, dates, addresses. If they raid me, the cell ends. I tell myself the journal is for after, when this is over. I have not yet been able to burn it.
Owl's brother died saving me on the Bridge job. Owl does not know the version of the story I have told them is the version that does not put me at fault.
I had a dream the night before this rotation. I saw Hawk standing alone on a roof at dawn, weeping. I do not believe in dreams. I have not stopped seeing it.
I love Wren. They do not know. I have not let them know because love is what they will use against us. The cell would forgive me but I would not forgive me if I lost them through my own want.
I survived a raid in which the rest of my old cell did not. They tell me I should be grateful. I am not. Grateful is a person who has not seen the others' faces every time I close my eyes.
